title: At the Iron Gate  (Près du portail en fer)

segments.t: Dehors sous l'ombre du tilleul à l'Auberge de la Cour du Tilleul, à Portland, le frère aîné, Owen, se tient bien droit dans son manteau gris face à Caleb pendant que Hannah pose une théière fumante et s'écarte d'un pas discret. Écoutez d'abord toute la scène.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Reprenons à présent chaque réplique de ces retrouvailles tant attendues.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
'Alors "quelqu'un avec quelque chose de la part de Grand-père", c'était toi depuis le début, Caleb.'
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
'Bonjour, Owen. Merci d'être venu aujourd'hui.'
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
'J'ai reconnu ta belle écriture moulée sur cette carte postale en deux secondes.'
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
'Attends, tu savais que c'était de moi et tu es venu quand même?'
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
'Bien sûr que je suis venu. Pourquoi t'es-tu caché derrière un billet mystère?'
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
'Parce que j'avais peur que tu sois encore en colère. Tu m'as manqué pendant ces trois ans.'
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
'Trois années d'entêtement... franchement, petit frère, tu m'as manqué aussi.'
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
'Excusez-moi, messieurs. Voici du thé bien chaud, et le gâteau tiède au citron arrive tout de suite.'
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
'Du gâteau au citron? Attends, comment savait-elle pour le gâteau au citron du vendredi?'
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
'Assieds-toi, Owen, enlève ton lourd manteau et regarde cette valise bleue.'
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
'Est-ce le vieux sac bleu marine de l'atelier de Grand-père?'
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
'Prenez tout le temps qu'il vous faut. La cour est à vous.'
Réécoutons l'échange entier avec toute son émotion contenue.
So 'someone with something from Grandfather' was you all along, Caleb.
Hello, Owen. Thank you for coming today.
I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.
Wait, you knew it was from me and came anyway?
Of course I came. Why did you hide behind a mystery note?
Because I was afraid you were still angry. I missed you these three years.
Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.
Excuse me, gentlemen. Here is hot tea, and warm lemon cake is on the way.
Lemon cake? Wait, how did she know about Friday lemon cake?
Sit down, Owen, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.
Is that the old dark blue bag from Grandfather's workshop?
Take all the time you need. The courtyard is yours.
Owen avait reconnu l'écriture de son frère en deux secondes et il est venu malgré tout! Dans la prochaine scène, le paquet de papier blanc s'ouvre enfin sous l'arbre de la cour. À tout de suite!
See you soon!
